question: Does the immutable current-main Duskblade cohort contain enough reproducible elite entry, elite victory, non-victory, whole-run viability and two-package separation to justify freezing exactly one elite-victory trigger for identity preflight?
competingOptions: freeze exactly the Duskblade elite-victory trigger for source placement and identity preflight
close the elite-victory trigger family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

scientificBasis.sourceBoundary: Current-main map generation authors elite nodes from row 5, MapNode maps them to elite combat, elite victory yields the existing elite reward schedule, and the root-551 policy gives healthy and low-HP elite routes separate weights. The identity-proved trace already retains every entered node and every fight kind/result.
scientificBasis.selectionBeforeCounts: Upgrade completion and potion use are not retained by this immutable trace, so neither can support a zero-row active/inactive estimand. Elite victory is the first remaining run-level transition that is both source-defined and exactly observed. No aggregate elite count was read before this protocol was frozen.
scientificBasis.differentStructuralAxis: An elite victory is a discrete run-route and reward transition. It is not a combat scalar, card-action grammar, named-card order, acquisition carrier, permanent card removal, death chain or turn-state Energy hook closed by prior issue #421 decisions.
scientificBasis.cheapestDiscriminatingEvidence: Reuse the 256 explicit-current node/fight traces already proved exactly identical to the 256 frozen current-main baseline rows after trace labels are removed. No simulator or ledger row is needed to reject sparse, universal or package-aliased support.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This is a necessary observational capacity screen. It cannot identify route preference, available alternatives, a causal elite effect, new payoff, carrier, product candidate or held-out result. A pass authorises identity preflight and reachable-choice telemetry only.

candidate.mediator: Completion of an existing elite combat with result win.
candidate.prospectiveTrigger: One observation-only Duskblade trigger emitted after and only after the existing elite victory and reward boundary. It cannot change combat, reward, map, policy, RNG, state or result.
candidate.payoff: Absent and deliberately undefined. No numeric reward, consumer, carrier or content definition may be chosen from this capacity result.
candidate.carrier: Unselected. A card, relic or effect carrier is outside this screen and cannot rescue it.
candidate.structuralDifference: The mediator is a run-level risk/reward transition already selected through the map policy and resolved through elite combat, rather than another within-combat card sequence.

eliteVictoryTrigger.level0: Exact current-main. No new trigger exists and path, RNG, policy, state and result remain byte-identical.
eliteVictoryTrigger.level1: Prospective identity-preflight level only: after an existing Duskblade elite victory, emit one observation-only trigger. No payoff or state mutation is authorised.
eliteVictoryTrigger.status: Fixed at level 0 in every cached row. Level 1 is authorised only if every capacity gate passes.

eliteVictoryPayoff.absent: No new payoff, magnitude, consumer, carrier or content definition exists.
eliteVictoryPayoff.status: Separate prospective causal factor. It cannot be defined or varied by this screen.

existingEliteReward.current: Exact current elite gold, card-rarity, potion and relic reward path.
existingEliteReward.status: Fixed existing reward; it is not the candidate payoff and is not varied.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.
scorelinePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed throughout and never bundled with Afterimage or elite victory.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Warden's Edge Afterimage payoff.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and elite victory.

eliteRoutePolicy.current: Exact root-551 routeLowHpPct, route.eliteOk, route.eliteLow and all other frozen policy coordinates.
eliteRoutePolicy.status: Fixed observational policy identities; no route remap or threshold is estimated.

wardSetupPriority.current: Exact current/null Ward setup path; no structural intervention.

designMatrix.kind: one immutable observational cell; not a factorial
anchors: exact current-main map, combat-kind, elite-reward and policy source
designMatrix.aliasStructure: An entered elite proves realised exposure, not that another reachable node was offered or that elite route weight caused the choice. Elite victory also depends on map RNG, HP and combat strength, and it changes existing rewards. Whole-run outcome and package overlap therefore cannot be interpreted as a causal route or payoff effect. These aliases only support or reject necessary trigger capacity.
designMatrix.expansionRule: No simulator or joint cell is authorised here. A pass may add only null-identity, post-victory mediator isolation and observation-only reachable-choice telemetry. A later mechanism-blocked CRN must keep policy identities, seed identities, baseline, first-look budget, estimator and stopping rule equal. Add targeted Scoreline or Afterimage joint cells only if preregistered shared-anchor interference has measured decision value; never complete a Cartesian product for symmetry.

capacityDefinitions.opportunityRow: The retained node trace contains an entered node whose type and combatKind are both elite.
capacityDefinitions.activeRow: The retained fight list contains an elite fight whose result is win; the same row must also be an opportunity row.
capacityDefinitions.robustOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are opportunity rows.
capacityDefinitions.robustActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are active rows.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows contains an elite victory.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows contains an elite victory.
capacityDefinitions.viableRobustActivePolicy: A robust-active policy has at least one elite-victory row whose whole-run outcome is win.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageRoutePolicy: At least two of four rows record positive afterimageGuardDamage.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Robust-active for elite victory but not active for the named package anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named package anchor but not robust-active for elite victory.

mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: eliteVictoryTrigger x eliteVictoryPayoff, because a future payoff can occur only after an elite victory
eliteVictoryTrigger x existingEliteReward, because both share the same transition boundary but must remain separate effects
elite victory x package acquisition/use, because elite rewards can change later cards, relics and package reachability
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.scorelineInterference: Scoreline payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact policy overlap is only a shared-anchor screen; it is not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.afterimageInterference: Afterimage payoff remains fixed and separate. Exact policy overlap is only a shared-anchor screen; it is not an interaction estimate.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.survivorshipAlias: The viability estimand requires a complete winning run after at least one elite victory, but does not attribute that win to the elite route or reward.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: Source and cached path evidence may advance to identity-safe trigger and reachable-choice telemetry. No payoff or whole-run endpoint can be claimed until every causal contrast evaluates it on one frozen equal cohort.

identityPreflightIfAuthorised.null: Omitted and explicit level 0 must reproduce exact policy, map path, combat path, rewards, RNG, state and result on all 256 frozen identities.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.enabled: Level 1 may append exactly one observation after each existing Duskblade elite victory and must change no game state, queue ordering, reward, policy or RNG. Ashwarden and non-elite victories are negative controls.
identityPreflightIfAuthorised.reachableChoiceTelemetry: At each chosen node, record the exact reachable node IDs/types, low-HP classification, frozen route scores and chosen node. Telemetry must be optional and state/RNG inert.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: Every explicit-current row must equal its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result exactly after trajectory and arm-label fields are removed before any elite count is read. Node telemetry must have the exact frozen six-field schema.

cohort.identity: Opportunity, victory, viability and both package anchors reuse the exact complete first-look rectangle. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

scoreline.definition: Chisel precedes a later Faultline in the same fight in at least two of four rows.

afterimage.definition: Positive afterimageGuardDamage is recorded in at least two of four rows.

estimands.unit: Frozen policy identity with the preregistered two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.primary: Exact robust-opportunity, robust-active, exact-inactive and ambiguous elite-victory policy counts and identities.
estimands.viability: Exact robust-active policies with at least one elite-victory row whose whole-run outcome is win.
estimands.stageBreadthDiagnostic: Exact act numbers in which any retained elite victory occurs; reported without a gate.
estimands.separation: Separate exact candidate-only, anchor-only, overlap and Jaccard policy-set statistics against Scoreline and Afterimage.
estimands.reliability: Exact cached stall/error rows under the immutable current arm.
estimands.notEstimated: No reachable alternative, route-weight effect, elite-victory causal effect, new reward, carrier, content definition, package interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected seed or product endpoint is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic immutable-source assertions, exact cache identity, exact node/fight predicates and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: One prespecified elite-victory substrate, one immutable cohort and one complete first look. No node/fight predicate, threshold, anchor, policy or seed may change after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Freeze exactly the one trigger mechanism only if every gate passes; otherwise close this family, or record inconclusive only when deterministic execution exceeds the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 opportunity/active/inactive and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy scale. Both packages retain the frozen 0.75 Jaccard ceiling, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline. No threshold depends on elite counts.

decisionRules.success: Opportunity, active, inactive, viability, separate Scoreline/Afterimage separation, source identity, cache identity, node/fight integrity and reliability gates all pass.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze exactly duskblade-elite-victory-trigger as the sole feasible mechanism for source-placement and identity preflight. Implement no payoff or content. First prove omitted/level-0 exact policy, map, combat, reward, RNG, state and result identity across all 256 rows, then prove on focused controls that level 1 emits only after an existing Duskblade elite victory and changes no simulation state. Add only observation-inert reachable-choice telemetry. A later preregistration is required before any payoff or simulator row.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete elite-victory trigger family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not alter the victory predicate, add elite-entry or elite-reward variants, tune route weights, invent a payoff, add a carrier or rerun this cohort.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Current-main source, immutable cache or deterministic decision cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, trace extension, payoff, carrier, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source validation, cache identity, candidate construction, node/fight classification, both package comparisons and stop/go. Issue #524 and #525 are immutable scientific evidence only and are not reconstructed. No model context, human label, optimiser, ML, RL or adaptive candidate iteration enters execution.

domain/state/map_node.gd: return "boss" if type == "boss" else ("elite" if type == "elite" else "normal")
